name: GC Content
description: Count G and C bases in a DNA window. GC content correlates with melting temperature and gene density — high-GC regions require more energy to denature. Uses DNA_GC_COUNT tile over a rolling window, reporting raw count for downstream MIF conversion to percentage.
author: system

pipeline.note: Count G+C bases in the window; output is raw integer count

validation: GC% = gc_count / window * 100. Human genome average ~41%. CpG islands typically >60%.
